newsitem.title: USA: PMT Services Inc to buy Bancard Systems.
newsitem.headline: PMT Services Inc to buy Bancard Systems.

text.p: PMT Services Inc said Monday it had signed an agreement to acquire Bancard Systems Inc, an independent service organization with a merchant portfolio of approximately 11,000 accounts.

PMT, which markets and services electronic credit card authorization and payment systems, said it will make the acquisition with 3,131,250 shares of PMT common stock worth about $45 million at the Nasdaq market's close on Friday.
The company said it expects the merger with Bancard, which would be accounted for as a pooling of interests, to close by the end of January 1997 and be accretive to earnings.
After closing the transaction, PMT said it plans to nominate Michael McCormick, president of Bancard, to become a member of PMT's board of directors.

"This transaction continues a strategic effort on PMT's behalf to increase its internal growth strategy by merging with high quality, professionally managed sales and service organizations in key markets," said Richardson Roberts, chairman of PMT.
PMT has now closed or announced six portfolio acquisitions during fiscal 1997, which ends July 31, 1997, the company said.
It said the acquisitions will add approximately 32,500 new accounts to PMT's merchant portfolio, which had 89,500 accounts at the end of the last fiscal year.
